claims: Lauren Betts (#51) is a 6-7 senior center for the UCLA Bruins women's basketball team.
Lauren Betts is a former McDonald's All-American.
Lauren Betts led UCLA to the 2026 Elite Eight.
Lauren Betts averaged 15 points and 10 rebounds while leading UCLA to the 2026 Elite Eight.
Lauren Betts ranked 2nd in the NCAA in field goal percentage (67%) during the 2023-24 season.
Lauren Betts is from Centennial, Colorado.
Lauren Betts played at Grandview High School.
Lauren Betts signed with WME Sports.
Lauren Betts is a center and senior on the 2025-26 roster.
Lauren Betts was named Most Outstanding Player (MOP) in the 2026 NCAA Tournament.
Lauren Betts led UCLA to their first NCAA championship.
Lauren Betts had a 16-point, 11-rebound performance in the Final Four semifinal of the 2026 NCAA Tournament
